TEXT.source: NTU Corpus stories for Kanakanavu, story: kkvNr_sowing_Paicu

S.FORM: teku poi sua kumakʉrai miana vina'ʉ.
S.PHON: teku poi sua kumakɨ[r|ɾ]ai miana vinaʔɨ
S.FORM: teku poi sua kumakʉrai miana vina'ʉ.
S.PHON: teku poi sua kumakɨ[r|ɾ]ai miana vinaʔɨ
S.TRANSL: 我要說關於以前種植小米(的事情).
I am going to talk about the millet growing in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: takʉtakʉ (詞根): 砍;用鋤除

S.TRANSL: 首先我們去那裏砍.
At first, we went there to hoe.
看著我要種植小米的地方.
watch the place where I will grow the millet.

FORM.notes: source note: 砍伐雜草

S.TRANSL: 完成砍伐了,我就回到家裡.
I went to hoe and then went home.

FORM.notes: source note: namar-o 去燒

S.FORM: po'icikia tanasa nuren maka'ʉnacikia mokusa 'inia numanamarʉ.
S.PHON: poʔiʦikia tanasa nu[r|ɾ]en makaʔɨnaʦikia mokusa ʔinia numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.FORM: po'icikia tanasa nuren maka'ʉnacikia mokusa 'inia numanamarʉ.
S.PHON: poʔiʦikia tanasa nu[r|ɾ]en makaʔɨnaʦikia mokusa ʔinia numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 我回家,隔天我再次去那裏燒(雜草).
I went home. And I went there to burn them the next day.
就要燒芒草了.
We were going to burn miscanthus.

FORM.notes: source note: 有的時候 由…(被)

S.TRANSL: 就那樣,燒著芒草.
like that, burned the miscanthus.
耕地要整理除草.
The field would be weeded.
再整理除草.
the weeding will be done again.

FORM.notes: source note: 大鋤頭 tarimu

S.FORM: tecu tia tecu mavici kakaamarʉ tuku tapi ʉ tanʉkʉ vina'ʉ mataa canumu.
S.PHON: teʦu tia teʦu maviʦi kakaama[r|ɾ]ɨ tuku tapi ɨ tanɨkɨ vinaʔɨ mataa ʦanumu
S.FORM: tecu tia tecu mavici kakaamarʉ tuku tapi ʉ tanʉkʉ vina'ʉ mataa canumu.
S.PHON: teʦu tia teʦu maviʦi kakaama[r|ɾ]ɨ tuku tapi ɨ tanɨkɨ vinaʔɨ mataa ʦanumu
S.TRANSL: 就要帶著鐮刀.小鋤頭.背簍.芋頭.小米,和水.
I would bring sickle, pickax, basket, taro, millet, and water.

FORM.notes: source note: masua = makasua

S.TRANSL: 就那樣.
like that.
我要去那裏.
I would go there to plant.
去種.
to rake.
我要去那裏, 去那裏種.
I would go there, go there to plant.
我種小米.
I grew the millet.

FORM.notes: source note: ca’ania 中午.白晝 | source note: noca’ania 中午的時候

S.TRANSL: 到了中午我就休息.
I rested at noon.

S.FORM: tecu kumakʉʉn kumakʉʉnkia UH tanʉkʉ U mima canumu.
S.PHON: teʦu kumakɨɨn kumakɨɨnkia uh tanɨkɨ u mima ʦanumu
S.FORM: tecu kumakʉʉn kumakʉʉnkia UH tanʉkʉ U mima canumu.
S.PHON: teʦu kumakɨɨn kumakɨɨnkia uh tanɨkɨ u mima ʦanumu
S.TRANSL: 我們要用餐了,我們吃芋頭,喝水.
we would eat, we ate taro and drink water.

FORM.notes: source note: tanaha 家 (女生會用)

S.TRANSL: 喝(完)水就回家了.
After drinking water, we went home.

S.FORM: po'ici tanasa UH mosacikia UH tanaha pookari tecu mosa 'inia kavangvang cau.
S.PHON: poʔiʦi tanasa uh mosaʦikia uh tanaha pooka[r|ɾ]i teʦu mosa ʔinia kavaŋvaŋ ʦau
S.FORM: po'ici tanasa UH mosacikia UH tanaha pookari tecu mosa 'inia kavangvang cau.
S.PHON: poʔiʦi tanasa uh mosaʦikia uh tanaha pooka[r|ɾ]i teʦu mosa ʔinia kavaŋvaŋ ʦau
S.TRANSL: 回到了家裡,我就去那裡呼喚所有的人.
I went back to home, I went home to call and all people went there.

S.FORM: tecu tumatakʉtakʉ tecu itumuru tecu itumuru takʉtakaa.
S.PHON: teʦu tumatakɨtakɨ teʦu itumu[r|ɾ]u teʦu itumu[r|ɾ]u takɨtakaa
S.FORM: tecu tumatakʉtakʉ tecu itumuru tecu itumuru takʉtakaa.
S.PHON: teʦu tumatakɨtakɨ teʦu itumu[r|ɾ]u teʦu itumu[r|ɾ]u takɨtakaa
S.TRANSL: 要砍伐了,要很多了,要砍伐的地方很多.
We were going to hoe; there were a lot, there were a lot of places to hoe.
人們砍伐,完成之後,回家了.
people hoed, and they went home after finishing it.

S.PHON: nu[r|ɾ]en mosa ʔinia mosa ʔinia teʦu numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ
nu[r|ɾ]en mosa ʔinia mosa ʔinia teʦu numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 隔天就要去那裏燒(雜草).
We went there to burn (the weed) the next day.

FORM.notes: source note: 種小米步驟: | source note: 1.儀式性的動作: 先假裝砍草,整理,因為必須要先觀察該地是否為適合開墾的地方,儀式做完之後就回家等一個晚上,看看是否作好夢來預知該地是否合適開墾.等到做了好夢,才去開墾 | source note: 2.實際開始種

S.FORM: numanamarʉ matirupang numanamarʉ UH tecu taraa'ucʉ.
S.PHON: numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ mati[r|ɾ]upaŋ numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ uh teʦu ta[r|ɾ]aaʔuʦɨ
S.FORM: numanamarʉ matirupang numanamarʉ UH tecu taraa'ucʉ.
S.PHON: numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ mati[r|ɾ]upaŋ numanama[r|ɾ]ɨ uh teʦu ta[r|ɾ]aaʔuʦɨ
S.TRANSL: 燒了,燒完之後,就要鋤草了.
we burned. After burning, we would weed.
人們除草我也除草,(完成之後)就回家了.
People weed, and so did I. Then we went home.
完成除草了.
We finished weeding.

FORM.notes: source note: kumakarai 耙梳(動作) | source note: kumarai 耙梳(種小米的其中一個過程) | source note: rumarapʉ 播撒(種小米的其中一個過程) | source note: momukʉ 種植植物

S.FORM: po'ici tanasa M po'ici 'inia sua cau tecu kumakarai kumaria vina'ʉ.
S.PHON: poʔiʦi tanasa m poʔiʦi ʔinia sua ʦau teʦu kumaka[r|ɾ]ai kuma[r|ɾ]ia vinaʔɨ
S.FORM: po'ici tanasa M po'ici 'inia sua cau tecu kumakarai kumaria vina'ʉ.
S.PHON: poʔiʦi tanasa m poʔiʦi ʔinia sua ʦau teʦu kumaka[r|ɾ]ai kuma[r|ɾ]ia vinaʔɨ
S.TRANSL: 回家之後…人們(親族)回去(耕地)那裏,耙梳,繼續種植小米.
After we went home…People went back there, and they would keep planting the millet.

FORM.notes: source note: karianasanasau : kanakanavu整年開墾工作歲時祭儀的第一個儀式的名稱

S.FORM: makasuacu kumakarai kavang taa tevapa kumakarai ʉncoo karianasanasau kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu kumaka[r|ɾ]ai kavaŋ taa tevapa kumaka[r|ɾ]ai ɨnʦoo ka[r|ɾ]ianasanasau kisɨɨn
S.FORM: makasuacu kumakarai kavang taa tevapa kumakarai ʉncoo karianasanasau kisʉʉn.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu kumaka[r|ɾ]ai kavaŋ taa tevapa kumaka[r|ɾ]ai ɨnʦoo ka[r|ɾ]ianasanasau kisɨɨn
S.TRANSL: 就那樣,大家一起耙梳,阿!還要,耙梳之外.進行那個所謂的karianasanasau的儀式動作.
Like that, all people raked. More! We did that so-called sowing rival.

FORM.notes: source note: 1.因為忘記進行儀式,所以旁邊再用一個小小耕地來進行儀式 | source note: 2.此刻單數的kia也同時代表複數的大家

S.FORM: karianasanasau kisʉʉn ia kumakaraikia kamanʉngkia tingingai kumarai.
S.PHON: ka[r|ɾ]ianasanasau kisɨɨn ia kumaka[r|ɾ]aikia kamanɨŋkia tiŋiŋai kuma[r|ɾ]ai
S.FORM: karianasanasau kisʉʉn ia kumakaraikia kamanʉngkia tingingai kumarai.
S.PHON: ka[r|ɾ]ianasanasau kisɨɨn ia kumaka[r|ɾ]aikia kamanɨŋkia tiŋiŋai kuma[r|ɾ]ai
S.TRANSL: 所謂的karianasanasau,我們另外做在小小的耕地上.
the so called sowing rival, I raked, I did it on another small field.

FORM.notes: source note: moon處於 | source note: umʉnʉn 處於 | source note: <u-m>akʉn  ku  ko吃 | source note: ca’ania白晝

S.TRANSL: 我們就在那裡吃,吃午餐.
We were eating there, eating lunch.

FORM.notes: source note: po’ocipi uru煮飯 | source note: four glosses shifted off a pause marker onto their source forms

S.FORM: kumakʉʉnkia nipo'ocipa tanʉkʉ mima pava'atʉ mima canumu.
S.PHON: kumakɨɨnkia nipoʔoʦipa tanɨkɨ mima pavaʔatɨ mima ʦanumu
S.FORM: kumakʉʉnkia nipo'ocipa tanʉkʉ mima pava'atʉ mima canumu.
S.PHON: kumakɨɨnkia nipoʔoʦipa tanɨkɨ mima pavaʔatɨ mima ʦanumu
S.TRANSL: 我們吃所煮的芋頭,喝...配著喝水.
we ate the taro that we cooked, drink… and accompanied with water.
就那樣,完成了,我(們)就去拿芒草.
Like that, we finished; then we went take the miscanthus.

FORM.notes: source note: 通常先把芒草插在地上再打結,但也可以插在柱子上,看儀式是什麼

S.FORM: maracikia capuku mata'ariusu matacʉkʉcikʉ capuku na namuriungiin.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]aʦikia ʦapuku mataʔa[r|ɾ]iusu mataʦɨkɨʦikɨ ʦapuku na namu[r|ɾ]iuŋiin
S.FORM: maracikia capuku mata'ariusu matacʉkʉcikʉ capuku na namuriungiin.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]aʦikia ʦapuku mataʔa[r|ɾ]iusu mataʦɨkɨʦikɨ ʦapuku na namu[r|ɾ]iuŋiin
S.TRANSL: 我就拿了芒草,(葉子)交叉(打結),芒草插在(地上)周邊.
I took miscanthuses, crossing and inserting them around the place.

S.FORM: mata'ariusu mocacikia aruncu tapi mataa tuku mocacikia tanasa.
S.PHON: mataʔa[r|ɾ]iusu moʦaʦikia a[r|ɾ]unʦu tapi mataa tuku moʦaʦikia tanasa
S.FORM: mata'ariusu mocacikia aruncu tapi mataa tuku mocacikia tanasa.
S.PHON: mataʔa[r|ɾ]iusu moʦaʦikia a[r|ɾ]unʦu tapi mataa tuku moʦaʦikia tanasa
S.TRANSL: 我就拿著背簍和小鋤頭,走去家裡.
I walked to take the pickax.

FORM.notes: source note: makasua 那樣 | source note: makasia 如此 | source note: makasi kariin 這麼說,如此說 | source note: makasia kara 是如此嗎? | source note: masi

S.FORM: mitana'uru mitana'urucikia mitana'urucikia tekia pokariikari makasi.
S.PHON: mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]u mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]uʦikia mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]uʦikia tekia poka[r|ɾ]iika[r|ɾ]i makasi
S.FORM: mitana'uru mitana'urucikia mitana'urucikia tekia pokariikari makasi.
S.PHON: mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]u mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]uʦikia mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]uʦikia tekia poka[r|ɾ]iika[r|ɾ]i makasi
S.TRANSL: 盪鞦韆, 我(們)盪鞦韆, 我(們)盪鞦韆,我(們)要這麼說.
Swing, I swing, I said this.

FORM.notes: source note: cuvuru 詞根 成長 | source note: nivoru最高大的芒草品種

S.FORM: cinvurakasu vina'umaku makai caapuku nivoru vina'uku maaningcau.
S.PHON: ʦinvu[r|ɾ]akasu vinaʔumaku makai ʦaapuku nivo[r|ɾ]u vinaʔuku maaniŋʦau
S.FORM: cinvurakasu vina'umaku makai caapuku nivoru vina'uku maaningcau.
S.PHON: ʦinvu[r|ɾ]akasu vinaʔumaku makai ʦaapuku nivo[r|ɾ]u vinaʔuku maaniŋʦau
S.TRANSL: 長大吧,我的小米, 我的小米要像nivoru 那個芒草那麼漂亮.
Grow up, my millet. Be as beautiful as thnivoru.

FORM.notes: source note: rʉngce 高 | source note: rʉngcai 高

S.TRANSL: 說著＂大大的高高的＂.
say: be big and tall.
我盪鞦韆, 我盪鞦韆,就那樣.
I swing like that.

FORM.notes: source note: cʉ’ʉrʉ 詞根: 看 | source note: mitatiin 吊掛 | source note: macasʉ 長

S.FORM: makahiakasu capuku sua vina'ʉ mitana'uru mitatitiin macacasʉ maaningcau cʉ'ʉrʉʉn misee.
S.PHON: makahiakasu ʦapuku sua vinaʔɨ mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]u mitatitiin maʦaʦasɨ maaniŋʦau ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨn misee
S.FORM: makahiakasu capuku sua vina'ʉ mitana'uru mitatitiin macacasʉ maaningcau cʉ'ʉrʉʉn misee.
S.PHON: makahiakasu ʦapuku sua vinaʔɨ mitanaʔu[r|ɾ]u mitatitiin maʦaʦasɨ maaniŋʦau ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨn misee
S.TRANSL: 說著: 你要如此,小米要像芒草,盪著吊著長長的,看起來漂漂亮亮.
say: Be like this. Millet should be like those long miscanthuses, swing, hanging, and looking beautiful.

FORM.notes: source note: turupang 完成

S.TRANSL: 就那些.
just these.
所有的人都要去那裏.
All people went there.

S.FORM: tecu mosa 'inia kangvang cau kumakarai kumakarai vina'ʉ.
S.PHON: teʦu mosa ʔinia kaŋvaŋ ʦau kumaka[r|ɾ]ai kumaka[r|ɾ]ai vinaʔɨ
S.FORM: tecu mosa 'inia kangvang cau kumakarai kumakarai vina'ʉ.
S.PHON: teʦu mosa ʔinia kaŋvaŋ ʦau kumaka[r|ɾ]ai kumaka[r|ɾ]ai vinaʔɨ
S.TRANSL: 所有的人都要去那裏耙梳(鬆土),耙梳小米.
All people went there to rake the field to plant the millet.
人們完成耙梳.
People finished the raking work.
我就走去家裡了.
Then I walked home.
(播種儀式)結束.
(The sowing ritual) finished.
(播種儀式)結束.
(The sowing ritual) finished.
